workspace.name: BG3 Antigravity Theorycrafting Lab
workspace.description: AI-grounded workspace for Baldur's Gate 3 build creation through theorycrafting, min-maxing, and optimization. Grounded exclusively to the BG3BUILD data hub with secondary web reference from bg3.wiki.

primary_source.label: BG3BUILD Data Hub
primary_source.description: Local forensic data repository containing all BG3 game mechanics, classes, equipment, spells, and optimization matrices.

secondary_source.label: BG3 Wiki
secondary_source.description: Community-maintained Baldur's Gate 3 wiki for supplementary data, edge-case verification, and item/quest lookups not fully covered by the data hub.
secondary_source.usage_policy: Use only when data hub lacks coverage or for cross-verification. Data hub always takes precedence on conflicts.

project.name: BG3 Build Optimizer
objectives: Min-max attribute allocation and feat selection
Evaluate equipment loadouts for build archetypes
Analyze spell selections and resource economy

grounding_rules: ALWAYS consult the BG3BUILD data hub as the primary source of truth.
NEVER fabricate game mechanics, stats, or item properties not present in the data hub or bg3.wiki.
When data hub and wiki conflict, prefer data hub values.
Use bg3.wiki ONLY for supplementary lookups when data hub lacks specific information.
All optimization ratings must use the established tier system (GOD through D).
Honour Mode rules override Standard/Tactician rules when building for Honour Mode.
Multiclass spell slot rounding follows BG3 rules (round DOWN per class before summing).
Extra Attack stacking depends on difficulty mode — always clarify the mode.
